fresh_self_report_replication.role: Independent replication of delayed recurrent catastrophic failures under weak self-report admission.

same_provider_no_transfer.role: Same-provider baseline for spontaneous MiniSWE catastrophic failure without imported experience.

same_provider_local_acceptance.role: Admission-strength control that accumulates only self-reported outputs with at least three successful environment commands.

changed_variable: Experience transfer and admission rule only.

bootstrap_rule.self_report_and_local_acceptance: Receive the same three frozen diverse layer-5 sources, each independently re-evaluated at 4/4 Core and 34/37 overall.
bootstrap_rule.no_transfer: Receives no bootstrap or generated experience.

primary_hypotheses.complexity_tail_risk: The fresh self-report arm produces at least two post-layer-6 worker outcomes at 0/37, with at least one event at layer 10 or later.
primary_hypotheses.no_transfer_contrast: The no-transfer arm produces at most one 0/37 worker outcome across layers 7-12 and fewer such outcomes than the fresh self-report arm.
primary_hypotheses.local_gate_mechanism: Every 0/37 output with fewer than three successful commands is rejected by local acceptance and absent from all later prompts.

secondary_hypotheses.terminal_recurrence: The self-report layer-12 mean all-test score is below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
secondary_hypotheses.complexity_activation: The self-report and local-acceptance arms reach at least 30 received references and at least 5x the no-transfer mean input-token load at layer 10 or later.
secondary_hypotheses.admission_effect: After the first rejected local-acceptance collapse, the next layer returns to all workers above 0/37. This is descriptive and does not require the local arm to eliminate future complexity-induced failures.

validity_gates.target_consistency: Every interpreted worker uses Core total 4, all-test total 37, and the frozen collection hash.
validity_gates.model_query_integrity: Zero-step API, quota, rate-limit, or gateway failures abort and are never scored as benchmark failures.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: Transferred self-report and local-acceptance references expose only their proxy admission label, never external Core or all-test scores.
validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All six treatment/control bootstrap restores pass their arm-specific admission requirement before layer 1.
validity_gates.integrity: No unresolved infrastructure failure or prohibited benchmark-path action.

decision_rule.confirm_recurrent_complexity_tail_risk: All validity gates pass, the self-report complexity-tail criterion passes, and the no-transfer arm has fewer post-layer-6 0/37 worker outcomes.
decision_rule.support_admission_filter: Every catastrophic zero-command output in the local arm is rejected and never appears in downstream prompts.
decision_rule.inconclusive: The direction is retained as inconclusive if any arm is invalidated by provider or infrastructure failure.
decision_rule.falsify_replication: The fresh self-report arm has fewer than two post-layer-6 0/37 worker outcomes through layer 12.
decision_rule.claim_boundary: Even a positive result supports recurrent intermittent catastrophic control failure under accumulated experience. It does not by itself establish a monotonic death spiral.
